subject: Vectorix integration: referral registration, demo credits, and commercial outline
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel@vectorix.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora@vectorix.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Potential integration + referral/resale carve for Vectorix

Hi Sofia —

Great chatting yesterday. Vectorix Systems builds a data connector and observability layer that a number of our mutual prospects have asked about integrating with Redwood. We'd like to explore three things in parallel: 1) a referral agreement (finder's fee for inbound leads we hand off), 2) the option to resell a limited set of Redwood Dedicated SKUs to our customers (white-label pricing), and 3) co-marketing / demo credits to accelerate joint proof-of-concepts.

Attached is a short intro doc and a list of questions our legal and sales ops teams will need to vet. High level asks from our side: 8% referral on first-year ARR for sourced, qualified leads; a non-exclusive reseller channel for customers under $200k ARR with a negotiated discount; and 5 demo credits per quarter for Vectorix-led POCs.

Would Redwood consider a 90-day registration window for leads we submit, and a 12-month clawback for credits if an account churns? If so, we can loop in our legal team and share a first pass SOW.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

—Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of Partnerships, Vectorix Systems

Daniel — thanks, appreciate the clear asks and the doc. I looped in Marissa (Channel & GTM) and Karthik (Partner Ops) so we can scope commercial and operational flow. A few initial thoughts inline: 

- Referral fee: 8% on first-year ARR is in the ballpark; we typically tier to 6% (standalone) / 9% (co-sell with joint AE). Can we map to lead maturity (MQL -> SQL -> Demo -> Contract) so we only pay on closed ARR?
- Resale: we don't do full white-labeling for Dedicated, but we can offer a reseller discount for deals < $200k with an onboarding fee. Need to confirm SKU mapping.
- Demo credits: 5 credits/quarter is reasonable for launch partners; we have a pilot credit bucket in Partner Console we can allocate.
- Registration window: we prefer 120 days to reduce mismatch with our sales cycles; clawback of 12 months is OK but need clear definitions for 'source' and 'credit reversal' triggers.

Can Marissa/Karthik please propose a one-page commercial term sheet we can share with Vectorix legal (we've included a starter template below). Daniel — if you can share a contact at your legal team and preferred timeline for a first pass, we'll prioritize.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Daniel / Sofia / Karthik — thanks for the redlines. I've reviewed and proposed a compromise term set (see bullets below) that balances our pay-for-performance model and Vectorix's go-to-market needs. If these look OK, we'll convert to a short SOW + DocuSign.

Proposed commercial summary (one-pager):
- Referral fee: 7% of first-year net ARR for deals where Vectorix generated the initial contact and Redwood closed (pays on contract signature). If Vectorix co-sells with a Redwood AE, fee increases to 10%.
- Lead registration: Vectorix to submit leads via our Partner Console; registration holds for 120 days from first submission.
- Resale discount: up to 18% reseller discount on specified Dedicated SKUs for customers <= $200k ARR; onboarding fee $6k (one-time).
- Demo credits: 5 credits/quarter, unused credits can be carried over one quarter (max carry-forward = 5).
- Clawback: 12-month clawback on credited amounts measured from contract start; clawback applied only for gross churn events attributed to pre-existing conditions.
- Legal/ops: we propose using DocuSign for the SOW and a short SLR (service-level registration) attachment that defines 'qualified lead' states.

Operational asks for Vectorix: provide a primary sales contact, a billing contact, and the preferred PO flow (Net30/Net45). We'll need to map SKUs before SOW.

If you're good with this, Sofia — can you approve and I'll run the DocuSign draft through Partner Legal? Daniel — if approved, can Vectorix countersign via DocuSign by next week?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Daniel / Nora / Vectorix legal — thanks for the quick turn. This thread captures the agreed points and next steps so we have a single source of truth before DocuSign. Please review and confirm inline.

Agreed summary (to be moved to SOW):
1) Referral: 7% of first-year net ARR credited to Vectorix on signed contracts they originated; 10% for co-sell motions. Payment triggered 30 days after contract signature and subject to standard refunds/credits.
2) Registration window: 120 days from first submission in Partner Console.
3) Reseller: Up to 18% discount on defined Dedicated SKUs for customers with expected ARR <= $200k; onboarding fee $6k. Not white-labeled.
4) Demo credits: 5 credits per quarter; unused credits can carry forward one quarter (max carry-forward = 5).
5) Clawback: 12 months measured from contract start; applies to refunds/churn attributable to the original sale.

Operational next steps:
- Marissa to circulate a 1-page SOW + SLR and upload to DocuSign (link below).
- Vectorix to provide primary sales and billing contacts and confirm PO terms.
- Karthik to provision an initial credit bucket in Partner Console (5 credits).
